objective: Update HolyAgent's docs on a 0.3.0 release branch so they describe the decided pi integration plan, without implementing it.
requirements: Maintainer (verbatim): "alright please update the docs in a 0.3.0 release branch" and "ask me questions for all open stuff and whatever else is needed"; earlier: "you aren't supposed to implement 0.3.0".

The docs record the plan as decided in the ten 0.3.0 pi Intents (decisions in /home/user/holyagent-work/pi-decisions.md, Intents in /home/user/holyagent-work/pi-intents-final.jsonl) and the sourced research facts; they describe it as the plan for 0.3.0, not as shipped behavior, and change no code.

Release model (repository convention): release/0.3.0/integration from main; this change on release/0.3.0/docs/pi-integration-plan; the first PR of 0.3.0 carries the bump made with mise run bump:minor as its own commit.
Do not change .claude/CLAUDE.md; keep the README's six fixed sections; detail goes in docs/.
Done means mise run verify passes with the build in sync and CI green including Windows.

Default (maintainer's standing instruction, "merge whenever merge ready"): the root squash-merges the reviewed, green docs PR into release/0.3.0/integration; the integration to main PR waits until the maintainer's 0.3.0 implementation lands, since main publishes a stable release.
